description: This collection publishes urban LoRaWAN message measurements whose temporal coverage consists of several hours on two days. Researchers from Brno University of Technology and partner universities release server-side records containing payloads and gateway reception metadata. JSON objects stored in CSV files include timestamps, frame counters, frequency, airtime, data rate and received signal strength. Gateway arrays allow the same transmission to be examined at different receivers. The Zenodo landing page offers the supplementary dataset free under CC BY 4.0. Field names follow the Ceske Radiokomunikace service and may differ from other operators. The short campaign cannot establish seasonal network performance. These observations can calibrate radio reception and message-loss assumptions alongside model-loraenergysim and model-lorawan-network-server-simulator. Reuse requires checking gateway coordinates and measurement conditions in the accompanying metadata.
name: Supplementary Materials for "Measurements of LoRaWAN Technology in Urban Scenarios: A Data Descriptor"
